data.one_liner: Flutter widget inspired by the classic Desktop-style tab component.
data.what_it_does: Provides a desktop-style tab component widget for Flutter with support for customizable themes and tab arrangements. Allows managing tabs, handling tab selection, reordering, and view building.
use_when: You are building a desktop-style application UI in Flutter that requires advanced tabs.
You need customizable themes for tabs with various layouts and styling options.
avoid_when: You only need the standard mobile-oriented Material TabBar.
You do not require desktop tab features like overflow menus and drag-and-drop tab reordering.
strengths: Supports classic, underline, minimalist, and folder themes.
Supports reactive UI updates and custom tab shapes.
Cross-platform support including mobile, web, and desktop.
weaknesses: API has breaking changes across major versions requiring refactoring.
Specific to tabbed UI patterns only.
data.minimal_example:
TabbedViewController controller = TabbedViewController([TabData(text: 'Tab 1', content: Container())]);
TabbedView(controller: controller);
